summary: Verified new agrocorp.co.in olive/serif theme + role-scoped Global Search feature. Backend /api/search tested across all 4 roles (11 pytest tests, 100% pass). Frontend UI verified: search input, Ctrl+K focus, Escape close, dropdown with grouped results, click navigation, role scoping for admin/site_manager/accounts/post_sales, page rendering regression across Dashboard/Projects/Team/Units/Sales/Inventory/Procurement, and modal spot-checks (Procurement new-request modal, Sales payment Update dialog). Theme renders correctly (olive #5a6b10 primary, Cormorant Garamond serif headings, Inter body, cream #faf8f5 bg). No console errors on any tested page.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is at 1061 lines; consider splitting into routers (auth, units, sales, procurement, inventory, search) for maintainability.
GlobalSearch.jsx debounce (220ms) fires a request on every keystroke >=2 chars; consider adding an in-memory LRU cache keyed by q for slight UX polish (not blocking).

In /api/search project link for non-admin is '/units' — clicking a Project result for accounts/post_sales lands on /units rather than a project detail; acceptable given the app doesn't have a project detail page, but sublabel could hint destination.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Used existing seed items: plot 16 buyer 'Ravi', 'Vacation Village Chikkamagaluru' project, TEST_Cement_Regr (inventory), TEST_Regr Request (procurement) under proj_53fb360c1f0a.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Global Search backend endpoint /api/search and frontend GlobalSearch.jsx are fully working with correct role scoping. Theme change is regression-safe. Login inputs use data-testid='login-phone' (type=text, not tel) and 'login-password' + 'login-submit'. To switch users in Playwright, clear localStorage/sessionStorage before navigating to /login (otherwise auto-redirect to /dashboard). Mark-Sold button on /units was not located via generic text selectors during quick spot-check — the units page renders correctly (unit cards visible) but the specific 'Mark sold' trigger may live behind a unit detail click or a per-row menu; main agent should confirm via data-testid if a deeper regression is desired. All other modals opened cleanly.
